<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="430" height="932" viewBox="0 0 430 932">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="430" height="932" rx="40" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="25" y="31" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="346" y1="25" x2="346" y2="30" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="22" x2="351" y2="30" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="19" x2="356" y2="30" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="25" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="367" y1="22" x2="373" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="384" y="19" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="387" y="22" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="407" y="23" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="32,77 22,87 32,97" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="94" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="28.92px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">My account</text>
    <circle cx="386" cy="87" r="23" fill="#965128"/>
    <text x="386" y="94" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">JL</text>
  </g>

  <!-- profile summary -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="143" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFFCC">PERSONAL DETAILS</text>
    <text x="30" y="174" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="24px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Jordan Lee</text>
    <text x="30" y="197" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Beauty enthusiast · Member since 2023</text>
    <line x1="30" y1="218" x2="400" y2="218" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- email -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="248" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Email address</text>
    <rect x="30" y="258" width="370" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="291" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1C1E">jordan.lee@example.com</text>
    <circle cx="370" cy="284" r="9" fill="#965128"/>
    <polyline points="365,284 369,288 376,280" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- current password -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="346" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Current password</text>
    <rect x="30" y="356" width="370" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="389" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="4" fill="#1C1C1E">••••••••••</text>
    <path d="M355 382 C363 371 377 371 385 382 C377 393 363 393 355 382 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="382" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- new password -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="444" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">New password</text>
    <rect x="30" y="454" width="370" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="487" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="4" fill="#1C1C1E">••••••••••</text>
    <path d="M355 480 C363 469 377 469 385 480 C377 491 363 491 355 480 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="480" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="51" y="531" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Use at least 8 characters with a number or symbol.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- confirm password -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="570" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirm new password</text>
    <rect x="30" y="580" width="370" height="52" rx="40" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="613" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="4" fill="#1C1C1E">••••••••••</text>
    <path d="M355 606 C363 595 377 595 385 606 C377 617 363 617 355 606 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="606" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#1C1C1E" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- update button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="672" width="370" height="54" rx="40" fill="#965128" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="215" y="707" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="20px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Update password</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="215" y="758" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, Arial" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Your password was last updated 4 months ago.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="797" width="390" height="83" rx="40" fill="#1C1C1E" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <polygon points="56,825 66,817 76,825" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="59" y="824" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="67" y="855" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Home</text>
    <!-- discover -->
    <circle cx="143" cy="827" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="834" x2="157" y2="841" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="143" y="855" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Discover</text>
    <!-- saved -->
    <polygon points="215,818 225,824 225,838 215,833 205,838 205,824" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="215" y="855" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Saved</text>
    <!-- account -->
    <circle cx="292" cy="822" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="292" cy="835" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="292" y="855" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Account</text>
    <!-- settings -->
    <circle cx="363" cy="827" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="827" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="363" y1="814" x2="363" y2="818" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="363" y1="836" x2="363" y2="840" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="363" y="855" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Arial" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">More</text>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="150" y="908" width="130" height="5" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
